tvShow.name: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
tvShow.originalName: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
tvShow.overview: Welcome back to Elmore, where the laws of reality are a joke, and family life is anything but ordinary. Whether he's battling an evil fast-food empire, facing off against a sentient AI in love with his mom, or trying to stop Banana Joe from wearing pants — Gumball Watterson drags his brother Darwin, sister Anais, and the rest of the town of Elmore along for the ride. With even wilder stories, bigger twists, and surreal humor, the show is so amazing that they had to rename it!

episodes.name: The Burger
episodes.overview: Gumball and Darwin want to find a healthy dinner option for their family because they are hooked on Joyful Burger, but an evil food consortium has monopolized the food industry.

episodes.name: The Assistant
episodes.overview: Feeling unappreciated by her family, Nicole strikes up a friendship with a sympathetic Al. As their relationship intensifies, the Al tries to drive a wedge between Nicole and the other Wattersons.

episodes.name: The Distance
episodes.overview: Gumball must find a way to save his relationship with Darwin after the boys are forced to live in separate rooms.

episodes.name: The Thing
episodes.overview: Richard must retrace the memories of his day in order to figure out what "the thing" is, so Nicole's family dinner with Granny Jo Jo won't be another epic failure.

episodes.name: The Butts
episodes.overview: Gumball must help Principal Brown have body confidence about his butt in order to be allowed to do his poem about butts at the Poetry Recital.

episodes.name: The Traffic
episodes.overview: The Wattersons must get Anais to Daisyland before the park closes for good.

episodes.name: The Astrological
episodes.overview: Gumball and Penny must stay together through the end of the school day to prove that they are meant to be together, despite an astrological prediction Mr. Small has made.

episodes.name: The Cheerleader
episodes.overview: Gumball wants to get Richard on the cheerleading team in order to end their family's generational trauma.

episodes.name: The Boring
episodes.overview: Gumball and Darwin use Molly's time-halting power (because she's so boring) to avoid an after school beatdown by Tina.

episodes.name: The Teacher
episodes.overview: Gumball wants to take down Miss Simian after she punishes him for not respecting his school-provided calculator.

episodes.name: The App
episodes.overview: Gumball and Darwin must stop an evil social media app from turning every kid in Elmore into mindless internet-trend-following drones.

episodes.name: The Entrance
episodes.overview: Gumball and Darwin attempt to make a big impression at the coolest party of the year with the most praise-worthy entrance the world has ever seen.

episodes.name: The Letter
episodes.overview: Darwin wants to get back a love letter he wrote to Carrie before she sees it.

episodes.name: The Gut
episodes.overview: When Anais enlists her dad's help with her science project, Richard's GUT becomes its own brilliant thinking entity, separate from the original Richard we all know, and Anais must choose between the two.

episodes.name: The Wrinkle
episodes.overview: Anais starts aging prematurely due to the stress and pressure of looking out for the rest of her stupid family.

episodes.name: The Gourmet
episodes.overview: After tasting Masami's gourmet, double-truffle mac-n-cheese at lunch, Gumball decides to do whatever it takes to get a full serving of the delicious meal.

episodes.name: The Pool
episodes.overview: In the midst of a heatwave, Richard enlists Gumball, Darwin and Anais to assist him in his mission to jump in the Robinson's newly-installed above ground pool.

episodes.name: The Portrait
episodes.overview: Nicole wants a new family portrait where everyone's entire face is in the photo and they're all smiling.

episodes.name: The Climb
episodes.overview: Gumball must face his demons and overcome an embarrassing incident from his past if he wants to finally summit the dreaded rock-climbing wall in gym class.

episodes.name: The Amadain
episodes.overview: Gumball vows to wear a shell and partake in strange Fitzgerald traditions, in order to help Penny get through a tense family birthday party with ease.

episodes.name: The Summoning
episodes.overview: Darwin joins a witch coven and lets the power go to his head.

episodes.name: The Unfollow
episodes.overview: When Gumball and Darwin realize that Sarah is no longer their number one fan, they try to get her attention back by whatever means possible.

episodes.name: The Promposal
episodes.overview: Penny wants to ask Gumball to the Elmore Jr High Prom, but when Gumball's expectations for an extra romantic and extra complicated gesture become way more than Penny can handle, Penny must find a way to deliver.

episodes.name: The Trumpet
episodes.overview: Nicole needs to make sure Gumball makes something of himself so that when he's older, he flies the nest instead of being a slob at home forever.

episodes.name: The Synthesis
episodes.overview: During School's Career Day, Nicole and Yuki unite to impress their kids and show the world their full power only to learn where real power comes from.

episodes.name: The Cheapmas
episodes.overview: After finding out Christmas is cancelled because Elmore is broke, Gumball and Darwin vow to save Christmas.

episodes.name: The Score
episodes.overview: Gumball and Darwin try to help Ocho overcome his anger and discover his life is much harder than theirs.

episodes.name: The Diary
episodes.overview: Gumball and Darwin find a diary. They discover the author is about to miss out on the biggest moment of her life and must find her to figure out why.

episodes.name: The Punishment
episodes.overview: Gumball and Nicole vow revenge on the driver of a car that cut them off.

episodes.name: The Roast
episodes.overview: After Gumball's smack talking embarrasses him in front of the entire town, he vows to curb his smug ways.

episodes.name: The Survivalists
episodes.overview: Gumball and Darwin go up against a squirrel in a primal fight for survival (...in their backyard).

episodes.name: The Labels
episodes.overview: When an evil guidance counselor arrives at school and gives all the kids awful labels, Gumball and Darwin must defeat her to reclaim their identities.

episodes.name: The Fools
episodes.overview: When nobody in Elmore is pranking on April Fool's Day, Gumball takes it upon himself to show them how it's done.

episodes.name: The Homework
episodes.overview: Gumball faces the most difficult journey of his life when he attempts to deliver Anais her forgotten homework on the day he is home sick with the flu.

episodes.name: The Sonder
episodes.overview: Gumball realizes that each random passerby is living a life as vivid and complex as his own.

episodes.name: The Mister
episodes.overview: Now considered a man in his culture, Idaho gets help from Gumball and Darwin as he attempts to handle his new adult responsibilities.

episodes.name: The Tracking
episodes.overview: The family tries to save Richard from the consequences of a bet involving a fitness tracker.

episodes.name: The Pants
episodes.overview: Disturbed by Banana Joe's decision to start wearing pants, Gumball does everything in his power to put a stop to it.

episodes.name: The Necroprancer
episodes.overview: Gumball and Darwin travel to the underworld with Carrie, intent on finding her a permanent body.

episodes.name: The Rewrite
episodes.overview: The boys are on the verge of discovering the truth about Elmore, but their old nemesis decides to rewrite the story.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Watterson family is back to prove that reality is just a suggestion in their wonderfully weird world. Gumball, Darwin, and the town of Elmore are more chaotic, hilarious, and bizarre than ever before, navigating a fresh wave of absurdity. This season tackles a promposal involving Penny faking her own death, outright pandemonium with wild animals invading the suburbs, and a witchy student cult attempting a yearbook séance.

alternativeTitles.title: El Maravillosamente Extraño Mundo de Gumball
